name: South Cairns Dental

items.name: Check-ups and cleans
items.blurb: A thorough exam, clean and polish, with a written plan you can take home.
items.desc: An examination of your teeth, gums and jaw, X-rays where needed, then a scale, clean and polish. You leave with a printed plan if anything needs attention.

items.name: Children’s dentistry
items.blurb: Calm, positive visits that help kids grow up comfortable with the dentist.
items.desc: Relaxed, positive visits that help children feel at home at the dentist, with problems found early. Free dentistry for eligible children.

items.name: Fillings
items.blurb: Tooth-coloured fillings that stop early decay before it goes further.
items.desc: Early decay is removed and the tooth restored with white, tooth-coloured filling material, usually in a single visit.

items.name: Mouthguards
items.desc: Custom-fitted mouthguards made from impressions of your teeth, for a snug, comfortable fit during contact sport.

items.name: Crowns and bridges
items.blurb: Strengthen a damaged tooth or bridge a gap left by a missing one.
items.desc: A crown reinforces a cracked or heavily filled tooth. A bridge fills a gap using the teeth on either side.

items.name: Root canal therapy
items.blurb: Treat an inflamed or infected nerve and keep your natural tooth.
items.desc: When a tooth's nerve is badly inflamed or has died, root canal treatment can often save the tooth instead of removing it.

items.name: Extractions
items.blurb: When a tooth has to come out, we take it slowly and keep you comfortable.
items.desc: When a tooth can't be saved, we explain why, talk through your worries and take it slowly so you stay comfortable.

items.name: Wisdom teeth
items.blurb: Assessment first. Removal only when it is actually needed.
items.desc: A consultation and X-ray show whether your wisdom teeth are a problem. Removal is only recommended when it's needed.

items.name: Dental implants
items.blurb: A fixed, natural-looking replacement for a missing tooth.
items.desc: A titanium post replaces the root of a missing tooth and supports a natural-looking crown fixed in place.

items.name: Dentures
items.blurb: First dentures, replacements for loose ones, or implant-retained options.
items.desc: First dentures, replacements for loose ones, or implant-retained dentures, planned around comfort and fit.

items.name: Teeth whitening
items.blurb: Professional whitening, supervised by your dentist.
items.desc: Professional whitening supervised by your dentist, starting with a check so you know what result to expect.

items.name: Cosmetic veneers
items.blurb: Thin porcelain shells for gaps, stains, chips and worn edges.
items.desc: Thin porcelain shells bonded to the front of teeth to improve gaps, stains, chips and worn or short edges.

items.name: Invisalign
items.blurb: Clear, removable aligners to straighten teeth without wires.
items.desc: Clear, removable aligners that gradually straighten teeth, without brackets or wires. Suitability is assessed first.

team.name: Dr Alex Bornsztejn
team.quals_long: Bachelor of Health Science in Dentistry, Master of Dentistry
bio: Alex wanted to be a dentist from early childhood. He grew up in Victoria, earned his dental degree from La Trobe University and completed his Masters in rural Victoria before moving to Queensland.
He has worked across Queensland, from Brisbane to Townsville, and is now proud to call Cairns home.

Alex enjoys all aspects of general dentistry and puts a high value on continuing education, regularly attending courses run by leaders in the field. His training has taken him overseas to learn techniques in dental implants and wisdom teeth surgery.
Outside dentistry, Alex loves time on the water fishing and with friends.

team.name: Dr Louis Fernandez
bio: Louis, known as Louie to colleagues and patients, grew up in a family of dentists who were passionate about oral health and patient care. That upbringing shapes how he practises today, with a strong focus on clinical excellence, patient comfort and mutual understanding between dentist and patient.

He has taught at university and worked in high-intensity hospital settings managing complex medical and surgical cases. Alongside his surgical interests, he enjoys all aspects of general dentistry and helping patients reach their smile goals, and takes pride in clear explanations and finding solutions that suit each patient’s needs and priorities.
Louie values learning and has pursued educational opportunities around the world to bring new techniques and technology into his practice.
team.quote: I’ve seen a need for excellent, thoughtful and careful oral surgery in Cairns for those who find sedation either expensive or daunting. And I am excited to go on these journeys with my patients, be it wisdom teeth extractions or dental implants.
